text:
elaine (Design): putting a quick mock here - heatmap over channels + a manual channel stack. goal: make noisy channels easier to scan and give teams a way to lock ordering. feedback?

sam (Product): nice. question: color = count or recency? maybe both?

elaine (Design): primary = normalized count in chosen window, secondary = recency via subtle glow. click tile for a tiny preview (one-liner + recipients).

kevin (Eng): perf note: render tiles server-side summary only, lazy fetch previews on interaction. also debounce hover requests. :gear: 

aria (A11y): accessibility: tiles must be focusable, with aria-describedby pointing at the preview text. also provide keyboard-only controls to open preview and move between tiles.

sam (Product): copy thought: "Notification preview" is vague. prefer "Whos notified" or "Example notification" depending on context. also propose a small "Pin order" affordance so teams can freeze a custom stack.

kevin (Eng): pinning: persist per-project. backend change: add pinned:boolean + order:int to channel config. UI should show a pin icon and keep pinned channels topmost.

elaine (Design): UX flow: default sort = severity then frequency. if user pins channels, we show a small banner: "Youve pinned channels for this project" with an undo.

aria (A11y): for reordering, expose an explicit "Reorder channels" mode and instructions: "Use Space to pick up channel, Up/Down to move, Space to drop". announce changes to aria-live region.

kevin (Eng): sample summary endpoint for heatmap tiles (UI-friendly):

```json
[{"channel_id":"c1","freq_score":"0.86","peak_severity":"high","last_snippet":"Error rate 12% on /api"}]
```

elaine (Design): copy tweak for thresholds: current label "SLO breach window" -> "Evaluation window" with help: "window used to measure firing frequency and error budget burn". presets: 1h / 24h / 7d.

sam (Product): also request that preview shows channel-specific sample (Slack card vs email subject line) and a short recipient list so users know who receives it. label it "Example notification" per earlier note.

aria (A11y): color alone cannot convey severity. add pattern overlays or icons for high/critical. ensure contrast and focus ring AA-compliant.

elaine (Design): will iterate: pinned channel visuals, hover debounce, keyboard reorder flow, aria-live updates, and pattern overlays. will post a short GIF for the design review.

notif-bot: Reminder: design review tomorrow 11:00 AM PT (agenda: alerting heatmap + channel ordering).

sam (Product): thanks all 12 drop quick blockers in-thread or ill add to the sprint board. :rocket:
